q: How long can I rent a bike?
a: From one hour up to 14 days. Longer rentals on request.

q: What does a city bike cost?
a: 4 euros per hour or 18 euros per day.

q: Do I need to bring ID?
a: Yes, a photo ID is required when you pick up the bike.

q: What happens if I get a flat tyre?
a: Call the service hotline. We bring a replacement bike within the city limits.
